timing_protocol.contention_note: Serialized after phase79 quality and phase80 preparation; revision_value explicitly confirmed no CPU/GPU experiments active and held inference; root held heavy checks during this interval.
timing_protocol.order: Cyclic occupancy/multiplicity/EBF order rotated by repeat; nine repeats give every arm each position three times.
timing_protocol.scope: Complete iterator: validation, state initialization, boundary discovery, input copy, scoring, selection, copied ordered event payloads and indices. Excludes I/O, JIT compilation, evaluation metrics and collected full-output concatenation. Includes Python iterator dispatch and a scalar checksum per window.
